name: Smartphone Digivice
description: Raise your Digital Partner inside the Courage Smartphone Digivice on Steam Frame.
author: josethevrtech
license: MIT (source); external assets retain their licenses
tagline: A digital companion, now in your world.
about: Smartphone Digivice brings Digital Partner into VR inside Jojogape’s Courage smartphone model. Pick it up, care for your pet, and place it anywhere in your space. The on-device settings control size, brightness and placement; name fields open the headset keyboard. Off stops the game and its audio. Saved pets and settings stay in the same private data directory across updates.
